# PDFKira - Free Online PDF Tools

> PDFKira is an online PDF toolkit. Processing and limits vary by tool; see each tool page for its specific behavior.

## About
PDFKira offers PDF tools for students, professionals, and businesses. Some tools process files in the browser, while others may use server-side processing. Check the individual tool page for accurate privacy and file-limit details.

**Website**: https://pdfkira.com
**Privacy**: https://pdfkira.com/privacy

### PDF to Markdown

- **URL**: https://pdfkira.com/tools/pdf-to-markdown
- **Processing**: PDF.js extracts text and supported embedded images in your browser; the PDF is not uploaded by this conversion workflow.
- **Input limit**: 50 MB and up to 300 pages.
- **Output**: Markdown (`.md`) for text-only conversions; a ZIP containing Markdown and extracted images when supported images are included.
- **Scanned PDFs**: No OCR is performed. Image-only PDFs produce no text; supported embedded images may still be extracted into a ZIP.
- **Tables and formatting**: Text positioning is approximated; tables are not guaranteed to become Markdown tables, and original bold/italic styling is not reliably preserved.

## Processing details

- **PDF to Markdown**: Convert a text-based PDF to Markdown in your browser. Your PDF is never uploaded. Free, no sign-up, up to 50 MB.
- **Server-processed tools**: Tools such as Merge PDF, Split PDF, PDF to Word, Protect PDF, Unlock PDF, image conversion, compression, and page operations may upload files to PDFKira over HTTPS for processing. Processing and retention details vary by tool; consult the [Privacy Policy](https://pdfkira.com/privacy).
- **Other tools**: Processing location and file limits vary. Check the individual tool page and the [Privacy Policy](https://pdfkira.com/privacy).

## Key Features Across All Tools

- **Tool-specific Processing**: Processing location and privacy behavior vary by tool; consult the individual tool page.
- **No Registration Required**: Use all tools instantly without creating an account.
- **File Limits**: Limits vary by tool. PDF to Markdown accepts files up to 50 MB and 300 pages.
- **Watermarks**: Whether an output contains a watermark depends on the selected operation; see its tool page.
- **Free to Use**: Completely free during MVP phase.

---

## Why Choose PDFKira?

PDFKira aims to provide straightforward PDF workflows. Processing location, capabilities, and limits depend on the selected tool; consult its page before use.

---

## Technical Implementation

PDFKira is built with:
- **React + TypeScript + Vite** for the frontend
- **pdfjs-dist** for PDF parsing, text extraction, and rendering in browser workflows
- **pdf-lib** for PDF manipulation in the workflows that use it
- **Deployed on Vercel** for fast global delivery
